NAME: JV-880
DESCRIPTION: Roland JV-880 PCM rompler emulation (port of the Schwung 'Mini-JV' module for Ableton Move, itself based on mini-jv880/Nuked-SC55). Headless: control it from a Force MIDI track via CC (Q-Link) or from the web panel. Requires the separate ForceAudioIn addon to be enabled (arms the shared injection tap at boot, zero voices) - this toggle only starts/stops the jv_host process itself, no LD_PRELOAD/acvs involved. Autoload is deliberately unavailable here: a voice must never be attached before an acvs restart - always start it after boot, from this page. Needs your own JV-880 v1.0.0 ROM files placed in this addon's roms/ folder (not included - copyrighted Roland firmware). See README.md / docs/CC-MAP.md.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ForceAudioIn voice slot (0-3; 1, not 0, to avoid Maze Voice's own default)
